conditional_capacity.chain_rule: Because X_N depends on (Z_N,W_N) only through M_N, I(M_N;X_N)=I(Z_N,W_N;X_N)<=H(Z_N)+I(W_N;X_N|Z_N).
conditional_capacity.coefficient: If H(p_N)+(1/2)sum_z p_(N,z)log det(I+A_(N,z))=o(N^3), then the label-dependent Gaussian-mixture class retains coefficient h_g^prof.
conditional_capacity.mean_scope: The means m_(N,z) are unrestricted by magnitude or separation; their transmitted information is charged through H(p_N), not a covariance determinant.
conditional_capacity.scope_guard: This closes only the entropy-and-conditional-capacity-subextensive common-floor class. Order-N^3 conditional capacity, absence of a profiled floor, and non-Gaussian or nonstationary components remain open.
